item_short_desc: Rothco’s Camo 3-Layer Polyester Face Mask combines comfort and functionality in a stylish, reusable design. The mask features a 3-layer construction that comfortably conforms to the shape of your face, making it ideal for extended use throughout the day. An adjustable nose bridge secures the mask in place and provides a snug fit around your nose, while soft ear loops offer a gentle yet firm hold. Please note, this mask is not intended for medical use and does not guarantee virus prevention.
description: Rothco’s Camo 3-Layer Polyester Face Mask combines comfort and functionality in a stylish, reusable design. The mask features a 3-layer construction that comfortably conforms to the shape of your face, making it ideal for extended use throughout the day. An adjustable nose bridge secures the mask in place and provides a snug fit around your nose, while soft ear loops offer a gentle yet firm hold. The mask is washable, allowing for multiple uses, making it a great part of your everyday essentials. The face covering measures 7 inches wide by 5 inches high, with two available sizes to ensure a proper fit. Whether you're running errands or at work, Rothco’s camouflage face mask offers reliable coverage and a lightweight feel. Please note, this mask is not intended for medical use and does not guarantee virus prevention.
